summary.zh: 构建可信的交易策略回测与验证流程
summary.en: Build reliable backtests for trading strategies

description.zh: 讲解如何避免前视偏差、幸存者偏差、过拟合和忽略交易成本等常见问题，并给出训练、验证与样本外测试的划分方式和走查分析流程。适合开发交易策略、搭建回测基础设施或验证已有策略表现时使用。需要自备历史行情数据。
description.en: Explains how to avoid look-ahead and survivorship bias, overfitting, and ignored transaction costs, with train/validation/out-of-sample splits and walk-forward analysis. Use it to build or validate a strategy. Market data must be supplied.
